1809-5744-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1809-5744-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Roshan, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Returned Pastcaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-728-5470-8201.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-5470-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

225-1021-5412-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, giving it flying until end of turn.
Repeat.

6553-6798-8207.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

5078-5243-7175-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

967-3809-5184-6495-7087.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
967-3809-5184-6495-7087.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

222-527-4068-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4068-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
222-527-4068-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5686-6972-7936.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it, so Dominion Saboteur will also enter with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

719-3413-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Xenograft, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

301-5961-7861.description:
Activate Clickslither by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat.

301-2376-7861.description:
Activate Clickslither by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Rhythm of the Wild.
Resolve the Clickslither ability.
Repeat.

862-1778-2997-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
862-1778-2997-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3175-6797-7424.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

1494-2450-4613-7152.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill The Thing.
1494-2450-4613-7152.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, returning it to your hand.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Thing's first ability triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Declare The Thing as an attacker. Its second ability triggers, causing you to pay {R}{G}{W}{U} to double the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate The Thing using Sage of Hours' ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
1494-2450-4613-7152.notes: You can cast any noncreature spell in lieu of Whim of Volrath. Whim of Volrath is strongly recommended as it guarantees you can cast a noncreature spell each turn, but you may omit it at your discretion.

1129-1268.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
1129-1268.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3121-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Master enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

339-677-5147-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2034-3734-4375.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

1274-3188-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3188-4186.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2921-6598.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting General Leo Cristophe.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing General Leo Cristophe.
When General Leo Cristophe dies, Saffi triggers, returning General Leo Cristophe from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When General Leo Cristophe enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

676-877-1374-5910.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature token.
676-877-1374-5910.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Magnus the Red and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with four or more +1/+1 counters on it

1597-4067-5672.easyPrerequisites: You have a nonland card in hand.
1597-4067-5672.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Gyre Sage.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and return a nonland card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1447-1734-2511.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
When Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

304-478-804-2821-3573.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
304-478-804-2821-3573.description:
Animate Candelabra using Tough Cookie
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Tolarian Academy.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

372-2417-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Pinnacle Monk exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2417-5913.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

851-4214-5189-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
851-4214-5189-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

225-630-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-630-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the Everywhere token.
Activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

719-2921-5853.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
719-2921-5853.description:
Cast Wick by paying {3}{B}.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

710-5231-5617.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Danitha, adding {R}.
When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

1235-2239-4705-5195.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, targeting Ardent Elementalist.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist with haste.
When the Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Twinflame to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.

628-2438-2781-3305.notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2438-2781-3305.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, its undying ability and Body Launderer's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Body Launderer.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 6, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger from step 5, blinking Body Launderer.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its undying and second ability triggers.
Resolve the undying trigger,  returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Body Launderer trigger, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any other permanent you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 11, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

221-1012-1116-2579-3977-5231.description:
Cast Horned Kavu by paying {2}.
Horned Kavu enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Wild Pair.
Resolve the Horned Kavu trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Wild Pair trigger, searching your library for Thermopod and putting it onto the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing itself, adding {R}.
Thermopod dies, triggering Sek'Kuar and The Cauldron of Eternity.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting Thermopod on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Graveborn, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 5.

2034-3603-4605-4681.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, blinking Karmic Guide.
Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Preston.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning any creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Karmic Guide, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Preston trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide that is a 0/1 white Illusion.
The Karmic Guide token enters the battlefield, returning the nontoken Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2366-2397-3470.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Dryad Arbor.
1409-2366-2397-3470.description:
Activate Dryad Arbor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Lotus Cobra twice.
Resolve both Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {1}{U}.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Dryad Arbor.
Repeat.

1636-2113-5251.notablePrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Emmara.
Emmara does not have summoning sickness.
1636-2113-5251.description:
Activate Emmara by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Emmara triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
The Human Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
